located_point.method: Not located. Starting point from Wikidata. Renders at 3 km and 1.5 km (RGB) show the Bolan river bed, fields and gravel fans; no mound could be identified with confidence.

imagery_unmeasurable_reason: Site not located at 10 m; no straight feature could be tied to Harappan architecture.

notes: The plan library has no Nausharo plan (status no-plan-found). We searched the Internet Archive for an open scan of the excavation reports (Pakistan Archaeology 24, 1989, and other Nausharo reports) and found none; a French mission poster on HAL that the search returned could not be retrieved (the server returned an access-denied page). No other openly accessible plan was found.
